analysis:
Examined all supplied patches, source and metadata. No independently supported security regression in this scope. Gemma4RequestGeometry.swift:11-76 preserves stage validation and checked KV-byte accounting while adding plan-derived rank geometry. Integration must verify plan validation guarantees positive rank counts, divisible head counts and bounded sliding windows before lines 33-35.
Gemma4TensorParallelChoice.swift:33-70 and Gemma4TensorParallelLanes.swift:157-213 add distributed greedy/sampled selection and rank-0-only logprob publication. Shape and vocabulary checks exist, but finite/range guarantees before Float-to-Int conversion (Choice:50; Lanes:188) depend on selection/sampler implementations not supplied. Review those contracts before concluding malformed collective results cannot trap.
Lanes:112-134 binds requests before opening histories and stores captures only after confirmed clean retirement. Lanes:292-359 checks admission, deadlines, owner capacity, aggregate memory and drained history; failures sweep prefixes, retain the driver for shutdown and fail control. T-010, T-028, T-041, A-001/A-018 and TB-007/TB-011 require integration with the shared batch driver, paged sessions and runtime lifecycle to verify cancellation, page isolation, shutdown drain and authorization invalidation. Lanes:283-289 bypasses locking while batchServing; verify executor confinement in callers rather than assuming concurrent public calls are supported.
LoadAgreement.swift:40-54 binds lane count, KV policy, prefix setting and data-plane terms; Lanes:365-374 compares request/load digests. Actual comparison timing and transport authentication/encryption remain outside these units. Prefix handling introduces resident and SSD retention: verify Prefix.open/scopes/store, authenticated cache scope, TTL, encryption, purge and kill-switch plumbing against T-041; the comments alone do not establish a production-policy deviation. No direct changes to coordinator encryption, attestation, billing or privileged helper controls were supplied.
